items.title: Message settings contain only message controls
steps: Open /messages/settings
Confirm the card is titled Message sounds
Confirm there is no Activity sounds picker
items.expected: Direct-message sound controls are isolated to Message settings.
items.evidence: Static composition verification: MessageSettingsPage mounts MessageSoundSettings only.
items.notes: Interactive visual smoke check still recommended.

items.title: Activity settings are available from Notifications
steps: Open /notifications
Click the settings gear
Confirm route is /notifications/settings
Confirm the card is titled Activity sounds
items.expected: Activity controls are located in the Notifications domain, not Message settings.
items.evidence: Static route and composition verification: NotificationsPage links to /notifications/settings; App.tsx registers NotificationSettingsPage; that page mounts ActivitySoundSettings only.
items.notes: Interactive visual smoke check still recommended.

items.title: Message and activity audio can be controlled independently
items.precondition: Two signed-in mutual users, socket connected, browser audio unlocked
steps: Enable and select a message sound, then disable activity sounds and save
Receive a direct message while not viewing that conversation
Receive a friend request, comment, or reply while not on Notifications
items.expected: Only the direct-message sound plays; activity sound is silent. Reversing the toggles reverses this result.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06 human confirmation: independent two-user message and activity audio behavior works in the local server session.
items.notes: Confirmed by the user after live testing.

items.title: Typecheck, lint, and production build
steps: npm run typecheck
npm --prefix frontend run lint
npm run build
items.expected: No failures caused by this change.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: typecheck and production build passed. Oxlint completed with six pre-existing warnings and no errors.
items.notes: The known warnings are in MessageQuoteStrip, AuthContext, ThemeContext, PostDetailPage, and PostPhotoCommentsPage.

items.title: Unread activity notifications persist until an item is viewed
items.precondition: Signed in with at least one unread comment, reply, or friend-request notification
steps: Open /notifications
Confirm unread activity row highlights and New badges remain visible
Confirm the navbar notification count remains non-zero
Confirm no bulk Mark activity as read action is present
items.expected: Opening the Notifications page does not change activity read state; each notification remains unread until it is individually viewed or marked read.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06 static verification: NotificationsPage load() performs no read mutation and the superseded bulk control is removed.

items.title: Each activity notification is read only when viewed
items.precondition: Two signed-in users; recipient has an unread comment/reply and a pending friend request
steps: Open /notifications and confirm both items remain unread
Open the comment or reply notification and return to Notifications
Confirm only that row is read and the count decreases by one
Use Mark as read on the pending friend request
Confirm it stays pending but no longer contributes to unread count
items.expected: Read state is individual and recipient-scoped; reading never accepts, declines, or hides a pending friend request.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06 static verification: comment/reply destination links call the recipient-scoped POST /api/notifications/:id/read endpoint; friend-request rows expose the same item-level action. NotificationModel scopes updates to recipient_id and read state; count queries include only unread pending friend-request rows.
items.notes: Friend requests reuse their existing notification rows and remain visible only while pending. Interactive two-user verification remains recommended, including a cross-user authorization attempt.

items.title: Notification destination back arrow returns to Notifications
items.precondition: Signed in with a comment or reply notification that opens a post or photo thread
steps: Open the notification from /notifications
Confirm the destination shows a back arrow labeled Back to notifications
Use the arrow
Open the same destination directly from the feed
items.expected: Notification-origin navigation returns to /notifications. Direct post or photo visits retain Back to feed or Back to post.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06 static verification: notification destination links carry the trusted return-state marker; PostDetailPage and PostPhotoCommentsPage accept only that boolean marker and resolve it to the fixed /notifications path.
items.notes: Direct destination routes retain their original feed or post return link. Interactive smoke verification remains recommended.
